rongmei.title: Adi tingsang tu cho aniu kandih ringmei

lines: 1. Adi tingsang tucho aniu kandih ringmei tingmik hei,
Neilamei munpuang tuai dat lak khe;
Aniu hei ntam dat khang tingmik kathan patdat kanthe,
Tam dat mak pui ram gaimei 2!- ninge.
Chorus:
Ntam makmei samei ram gaimei khou,
Jianmei nun le nban thaini;
Gakloumei guang khrista kanloumeipu,
Neilamei hu khou rianramei 2!- manni.
2. Kandih ram hei khou hei kapma huaina rianra bamsini,
Rianramei pang khou ram gaimei nai;
Kanloumei guang khrista thei laikhou
rianraloumei guaimu,
Hei ramgai khou 2!- aniuni lungni.
3. Neilamei munpuang bam kanloumeipu khrista bampui ram,
Jaolo ai tingmik thui ning bamme;
Tingkau latdiu nun le njianmei ntam kanmei guai le,
Tabui nung neilana kariu nicho?
4. He njianmei nun le katan tanh khang 2!- aleao maknga,
Kagan hei tingmik thui na guang the;
Lauthuan ganphiu gan gaimei 2!- guang khang tingmik heicna the,
Tan hei tan luai pukhou nban thaini.
5. He pou kanloumeipu neilamei munpuang gaimei nang e,
Kandih neilamei munpuang tuai the;
Nang jau khou2!- he pou neilamei tuang kapumma patdiu,
Neilamei Sharon mun gai nang.
